episodeTitle.en: How Anthropic’s product team moves faster than anyone else | Cat Wu (Head of Product, Claude Code)
episodeTitle.zh: Anthropic产品团队如何比任何人都更快行动 | 吴佳佳（Cat Wu，产品负责人）

guestBioOfficial.en: Cat Wu is Head of Product for Claude Code and Cowork at Anthropic, building one of the most important AI products of this generation. Before joining Anthropic, Cat spent years as an engineer and briefly worked in VC. Today, she’s interviewing hundreds of product managers who are trying to break into AI—and seeing firsthand what separates those who thrive from those who fall behind. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh:
吴佳佳（Cat Wu）是Anthropic公司Claude Code和Cowork部门的产品负责人，致力于打造这一代最重要的AI产品。在加入Anthropic之前，吴佳佳曾担任工程师多年，还曾短暂涉足风险投资领域。如今，她正在采访数百名试图进军AI领域的产品经理，亲眼见证了哪些人能在行业中脱颖而出，哪些人会被淘汰。  
*我们将探讨：*

title.en: How Anthropic’s product team moves faster than anyone else | Cat Wu (Head of Product, Claude Code)
title.zh: Anthropic产品团队如何比任何人都更快行动 | 吴佳佳（Cat Wu，产品负责人）

summary.en: Cat argues the hardest part isn't building for a future superintelligent model but eliciting maximum capability from today's models, and that shipping timelines at Anthropic have collapsed from six months to as little as a day. She says the PM role is changing fast—what matters most now is product taste, since code is cheap and deciding what to build is the scarce skill. The conversation covers what emerging PM skills look like in an AI-native world.
summary.zh: Cat 认为，难点不在于为未来的超级智能模型构建，而在于从今天的模型中“逼出”最大能力，且 Anthropic 的功能交付周期已从六个月缩短到最短一天。她说 PM 角色正快速变化——如今最重要的是产品品味，因为代码廉价，而“决定造什么”才是稀缺技能。对话涵盖了在 AI 原生世界里新兴 PM 技能的样子。
